title: Frozen Enchants
description: Frozen Arsenal introduces a suite of balanced ice enchantments designed to enhance Minecraft combat. Master the elements with dynamic frost spells, life-stealing soul frost, and powerful area-of-effect freezing mechanics.
body:
![FrostBeam](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/acc4c1997b62f8039f0533d911d145116f042109.gif)
  ---

  ❄️ Frozen Enchants

  Frozen Enchants is a premium-quality enchantment mod that brings the raw power of the eternal cold to your arsenal.
  Discover 8 unique, ice-themed enchantments featuring stunning visual effects, tactical depth, and a focus on balanced
  gameplay.

  Whether you want to summon crushing avalanches, trap enemies in glacial cages, or drain their life with soul-chilling
  magic, Frozen Enchants provides a fresh, spectacular way to dominate the battlefield.

  ---

  ✨ The Arsenal

  🗡️ Sword & Melee
   * Glacial Spikes: Every strike has a chance to summon sharp ice spikes from the earth. Synergy: Deals bonus flat
     damage if the target is already partially frozen!
   * Frost Nova: A powerful AoE blast. Freezes all nearby enemies and marks them. Marked enemies take 1.6x Shatter
     damage on the next hit.
   * Frozen Heart: Killing an enemy creates a temporary cage of melting frosted ice. Successive hits build stacks; at
     max stacks, the target's "heart" explodes in a massive frost burst.
   * Soul Frost: Drains the heat from your foes. Steals health to heal you while applying heavy Slowness III+ and Mining
     Fatigue.

  🏹 Ranged & Special
   * Arctic Arrow (Bows/Crossbows): Infuse your arrows with frost. High-level arrows can completely encase a target in a
     block of ice for a short duration.
   * Ice Lance (Tridents): Your trident becomes a tool of winter. Melee hits cause massive knockback with a giant spike,
     while throws create a wall of ice perpendicular to the impact.
   * Avalanche: Summons heavy ice blocks from the sky above your target, crushing them and slowing everyone in the
     impact zone.
   * Frostbomb: Leaves an invisible ice trap on the ground. When triggered by proximity or a hit, it detonates into a
     massive ring of jagged stalagmites.

  ---

  ⚖️ Balanced for Gameplay
  We believe enchantments should be powerful but fair. Frozen Enchants has been carefully tuned:
   * Tactical Cooldowns: Effects have internal cooldowns (4-8 seconds) to prevent spamming and reward well-timed
     attacks.
   * Fair CC: Effects like Slowness are strong, but "hard stuns" (like full encasing) are brief and balanced for PvP.
   * World-Friendly: Frozen Heart's ice cages use Frosted Ice, which melts naturally and won't clutter your world.

  ---

  🛠️ Compatibility
   * Platforms: Supports Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge.
   * Version: Optimized for Minecraft 1.21.1.
   * Performance: Uses modern Display Entities for high-quality visuals with minimal impact on FPS or server TPS.

  ---

  📦 Requirements
   * Fabric: Requires Fabric API (https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
   * Forge/NeoForge: No additional dependencies.

  ---
